question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：巴西 vs 海地（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Brazil vs Haiti (three-way 90-minute result)
one_liner_cn: 巴西与海地 Elo 差距高达 443 分，即便内马尔伤情存疑，巴西仍以约 76% 概率强势领跑，海地爆冷空间很小。
one_liner_en: With a 443-point Elo gap over Haiti, Brazil are strong favourites at roughly 76% even with Neymar's fitness in doubt; an upset has little room.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 443 分（巴西 1991 vs 海地 1548），Davidson 三路模型给出巴西约 78.5% 基础胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 443-point Elo gap (Brazil 1991 vs Haiti 1548) yields a ~78.5% base win probability for Brazil in the Davidson three-way model.

key_reasons.cn: 内马尔二级小腿拉伤、出战成疑，但巴西阵容深度（维尼修斯、拉菲尼亚等）足以覆盖，仅构成小幅不确定性。
key_reasons.en: Neymar's grade-two calf strain leaves him doubtful, but Brazil's depth (Vinicius Jr, Raphinha, etc.) covers it, adding only modest uncertainty.

key_reasons.cn: 海地新增英超即战力（伊西多尔 3 月改披海地战袍、贝勒加德入选），且预期对巴西摆低位防守，Elo 可能略微低估其防守韧性。
key_reasons.en: Haiti added Premier League talent (Isidor switched allegiance in March; Bellegarde in squad) and is expected to defend deep vs Brazil, so Elo may slightly understate their resilience.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> bounded evidence adjustment (-2pp Brazil, +1.5pp draw, +0.5pp Haiti; cap +/-8pp) -> renormalized. No betting/prediction-market data used.
